name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Marketing API, part of the Graph API, for reading and managing ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads and Insights reporting.
auth_notes: Facebook Login OAuth user access tokens (ads_read / ads_management); long-lived (~60 days) and non-expiring System User tokens for server jobs. No API key; app ID/secret identify the app. Per third-party guides citing Meta docs; official pages returned errors to the fetcher.
access_notes: Own ad accounts: standard access to ads_read/ads_management works without review. Managing other businesses' accounts needs advanced access via per-permission App Review and business verification. Marketing API tier Limited (default) vs Full (500 successful calls in 15 days, under 15% errors). Free per call. Evidence is third-party summaries of Meta docs.

buildability.rationale: Public Graph/Marketing API with self-serve app creation; multi-tenant use requires App Review, business verification and Full-tier rate limits. Official MCP at mcp.facebook.com is in open beta per a third party.

needs_human_reason: Meta developer docs were not fetchable (error pages); claims rest on third-party guides and the official SDK README. Verify tier names, sandbox, webhooks on developers.facebook.com.

evidence.quote: To manage the Marketing API, please visit your App Dashboard and add the Marketing API product to your app.
If it manages other people's ad accounts (an agency tool or a SaaS product), you need advanced access, which goes through App Review per permission.
at least 500 successful Marketing API calls in the last 15 days, and an error rate under 15% across your last 500 calls
MCP endpoints accept POST for JSON-RPC; GET is not supported.

disputes.why: Third-party guides citing Meta docs: other accounts need advanced access via App Review; own accounts do not.
Facebook Login access tokens and System User tokens.
mcp.facebook.com/ads responds as an MCP JSON-RPC endpoint; open beta per Variafy guide.
Public API with app review gating for multi-tenant use.
Marketing API covers campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences, catalogs, insights; Business SDK bundles many APIs.
Canonical docs, though fetcher got error pages.
